_comment: THE WNBA SUPER SEASON ROSTER — a NAMED list, not a rule, and that is what makes it different from every other set in this repo. The 2026-27 pool is MPG>=12 & G>=40, the WNBA set is MPG>=16 & G>=20; both answer 'who is good enough to card this year'. This set answers a question no threshold can: which retired players are LEGENDS. The user named these sixteen, and scripts/cardgen/wnba/generateWnbaLegends.js cards exactly them — no rule adds anyone and none of them can be dropped by one. A name matching no row in the archive is reported and the run exits non-zero rather than leaving the set quietly one player short. Keyed by the player name exactly as Basketball-Reference's WNBA tables spell it; the value is the era, which is documentation and is never read. NOTE ON SPELLING: the user's list read 'Lisa Lesia', which is Lisa Leslie — corrected here because the join is by name and a typo would silently cost her a card. Every other name was already Basketball-Reference's spelling.
